ann.t: Outcome of Board Meeting — Karamtara Engineering Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

Press Release — Karamtara Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 07, 2026, titled "Karamtara Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about copy of Newspaper Publication of unaudited financial results of the Company for the quarter ended on June 30
